title: Cost Experimentation Orchestrator: Channelized Trials for Batching/Caching/Quantization
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create an orchestration and tracking layer for controlled, channel-based experiments that applies batching, KV-prefetch caching, and quantization profiles to live traffic. The goal is to safely discover per-customer and per-route economic knobs that reduce token cost while preserving quality and latency SLOs. This initiative builds the experiment primitives, automated safety guardrails, and dashboards necessary to run hypothesis-driven econ experiments at scale.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment orchestrator deployable to two customer-facing channels (canary + gradual) with toggle-by-route and toggle-by-customer
Golden signal dashboard surfaces cost per 1k tokens, p95 latency, quality delta (ROUGE/BLEU or task-specific eval) and inference throughput, updated in <90s
Auto-rollback guardrail triggers on >5% quality regression or >10% latency SLO violation for affected traffic slice
At least three reproducible experiments run: adaptive batching profile, KV-prefetch on popular prefixes, and 4-bit quant profile; each report includes cost delta and quality impact
Experiment results exportable to CSV and linked to PR/decision notes in Confluence
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): instrument metrics, implement toggle-by-route, and run internal canary on non-critical traffic. Phase 2 (3 weeks): run customer pilot with 5 selected customers across low/medium/high throughput buckets. Phase 3 (ongoing): promote winning policies to dedicated autoscale profiles and bake into Optimize recommendations. Each phase includes at least one A/B test and a post-mortem noting signals and decisions.
